title: Elucidating the mechanism of fulvic acid-mediated PCR inhibition and its mitigation through nanoparticle-assisted amplification.
authors: Vajpayee, Kamayani; Srivastava, Shriyansh; Sharma, Shivkant; Gupta, Swadha; Srivastava, Ashutosh; Paida, Vidhi; Dash, Hirak Ranjan; Pappachan, Anju; Shukla, Ritesh K; Sengupta, Souvik
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟研究腐殖酸与Taq DNA聚合酶的分子互作机制，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作界面但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA结合建模，故给5分。
abstract: Fulvic acid is a common humic contaminant found in soil-matrix forensic samples and is a highly effective PCR inhibitor. This work uses computational analysis to investigate its molecular interaction with Taq DNA polymerase and evaluate nanoparticle-based facilitation strategies. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations proposed selective binding of fulvic acid with catalytic residues (ARG587, ASP610, PHE667, TYR671, ASP785, GLU786), affecting DNA binding, active-site geometry, and Mg(2)(+) coordination. Tryptophan quenching assays confirmed a low-affinity ( approximately 251.6 +/- 2.2 microM), reversible interaction. Functionally, fulvic acid reduced the peak height by > 80 % within the DNA profile and affected critical loci-D18S51, Penta D, D22S1045, FGA, CSF1PO, and D21S11. Nano-based facilitators-bare and BSA-coated AuNPs-were compared with the commonly employed BSA; the latter showed a statistically significant (p < 0.0001) 25 % TPH improvement compared to the inhibited level but did not affect allelic balance. These findings establish the inhibitory mode for fulvic acid and confirm the effectiveness of BSA-coated AuNPs as a scalable solution to restore PCR efficiency to environmentally compromised forensic DNA samples over highly concentrated application of BSA as a facilitator.
abstract_zh: 富里酸是土壤基质法医样本中常见的腐殖质污染物，并且是一种高效的PCR抑制剂。本研究利用计算分析探讨其与Taq DNA聚合酶的分子相互作用，并评估基于纳米颗粒的促进策略。分子对接和分子动力学模拟提出富里酸与催化残基（ARG587、ASP610、PHE667、TYR671、ASP785、GLU786）的选择性结合，影响DNA结合、活性位点几何结构以及Mg(2)(+)配位。色氨酸淬灭实验确认了一种低亲和力（约251.6 ± 2.2 微摩尔）、可逆的相互作用。功能上，富里酸使DNA图谱中的峰高降低超过80 %，并影响关键位点——D18S51、Penta D、D22S1045、FGA、CSF1PO和D21S11。基于纳米颗粒的促进剂——裸金纳米颗粒和BSA包被的金纳米颗粒——与常用的BSA进行了比较；后者在统计学上显著（p < 0.0001）将总峰高（TPH）提高了25 %，相较于受抑制水平，但未影响等位基因平衡。这些发现确立了富里酸的抑制模式，并确认BSA包被的金纳米颗粒作为一种可扩展的解决方案，在高度浓缩的BSA作为促进剂的应用中，能有效恢复环境受损法医DNA样本的PCR效率。
